text:
ana: Quick heads-up — starting an admin entitlement cleanup this week. goal: remove stale console/admin grants, validate owners, and close audit gaps for KMS bindings. planning to run a staged rollout (canary teams -> org-wide).

matt: SGTM. timeline? canary scope?

ana: aiming to start canary tomorrow PST, 2 teams (billing + telemetry). full rollout over 2 weeks if no regressions.

tara: what metrics/alerts should we watch during canary? audit log gaps were the last blocker.

ana: good call. monitor: failed auth spikes, service-account 403s, and KMS GrantDenied errors. set short-lived alerts: >5 auth errors/min for canary org.

joe: do we have a pre-checklist for ownerproof? last time we hit a bunch of ownerless service accounts.

ana: yes — owners.csv (owner,email,team,resource) + proof links. request owners to ack in the spreadsheet. any svcacct without ack after 48h -> mark for temporary removal.

samir: how are we handling KMS key bindings? there were cross-account grants that needed special handling.

ana: two paths: 1) preserve bindings with explicit owner confirmation; 2) if cross-account and owner unresponsive, move key to restricted policy and open ticket to product/security for re-eval. avoid blind removal of KMS grants.

matt: can someone drop the quick query for audit log gaps? I can wire alerts.

joe: here's a quick BigQuery-ish snippet we used:
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail as user,
       resource.labels.project_id as project,
       COUNT(1) as err_count
FROM `company-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protoPayload.status.code = 7 -- PERMISSION_DENIED
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
GROUP BY user, project
ORDER BY err_count DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

matt: perfect, I'll turn that into a 1m rolling alert on canary projects.

tara: edge case: long-lived CI tokens tied to admin role — we should exempt known infra CI until owners rotate. any objections?

samir: exempt list is fine but require task to rotate within 7 days. add to playbook.

ops-bot: deploybot: alert rule "admin-entitlement-canary-auth-errors" created by matt at 2022-05-05T15:40:22Z :white_check_mark:

ana: ops-bot thanks. last thing — runbook snippet for rollbacks:
- if >10% of requests hit 403 in 15m -> revert entitlement change for that role and notify affected team
- if KMS GrantDenied observed for production key -> immediately restore bindings and open incident with sec-oncall
- document every rollback in the spreadsheet with root cause and owner ack

joe: bump — who owns the rollback step during canary?

tara: i'll act as rollback owner for the first canary window. matt will lead alert reviews.

matt: will also add a tiny dashboard widget (errors by role) to console.

ana: awesome. I'll post owners.csv and the exemption list in the security drive, link in #eng-security before EOD. please review and ack. :thumbsup:

samir: acked — will check cross-account kms grants list and flag any with >1 external principal.

joe: i'll prep a short note for SRE on-call so they know what to watch.

tara: thanks everyone. we should be able to keep blast radius small with this plan. :party_parrot:

ana: closing the loop later with a quick postmortem after rollout completes.
